We get asked about cancelling time off that was already approved in two or three different ways. The answer below is the one that suits most venues, and the note at the end covers the rest.

1. Open the booking from the staff record and press Cancel.
2. Say whether the days go back on the allowance; they do by default.
3. Confirm, and the block comes off the rota for those days.

Only owners and managers can do this. A staff account can see the page but the buttons are greyed out.

Cancelling frees the days but does not put any shifts back. Whatever you took off the rota when the holiday was approved has to be rota'd again by hand.

articles.title: Carrying holiday into next year
articles.body:
This page covers carrying holiday into next year from start to finish. It lives under Settings > Time off.

1. Open Settings > Time off and set how many days may be carried.
2. Set the date by which carried days must be taken, if you have one.
3. On the first day of the new year, anything left up to that limit moves across.

The rest of the team carry on working while you do this. Nothing is taken offline.

Everything here can be undone from the same page, so it is worth trying it out on a quiet day before you lean on it.

The carry happens once, overnight on the first day of the new holiday year. Changing the limit after that does not go back and redo it, so anybody you have missed has to be adjusted on their own record.

articles.title: Correcting an allowance halfway through the year
articles.body:
Here is what we tell people who write in about correcting an allowance halfway through the year. Start at Time off and work down the page.

1. Open the staff record and set the override under Allowance.
2. Add an adjustment line instead if you only want to give or take a day or two.
3. Save, and the figure they see changes the next time they open the app.

It applies from today forward. Anything that has already gone through is left as it was.

It is easier on a laptop than on a phone, because there is more room on the screen.

This is one of the few things an owner can do that a manager cannot, so it may need somebody else in the building.

An adjustment line stays on the record with your name and the date on it, which is the version to use when you want to be able to explain it later.

articles.title: Holiday owed to somebody leaving
articles.body:
The short version of holiday owed to somebody leaving is below. The note at the bottom is worth reading as well as the steps.

- Mark them as a leaver with their last day.
- Open their time off page and read the figure marked Owed at leaving.
- It is the allowance earned up to the last day, less what they have taken.

Whoever it affects is told by email, and the email says who made the change.

If you look after more than one venue this is set per venue and is not shared between them, so it is worth doing at each site in one sitting.

The figure can be negative if somebody has taken more than they had earned by the time they left, and the page says so in words rather than showing a minus sign.

articles.title: How many people you let off at once
articles.body:
Short answer on how many people you let off at once: it is all at Settings > Time off, and the steps below take you through it.

- Open Settings > Time off and set the most people who may be off on any one day.
- Set it per role if your kitchen and your floor need counting separately.
- Requests that would take you over show a warning to whoever is approving.

Give it a moment on venue wifi. The page catches up on its own and there is no need to do it twice.

On a phone, turn it sideways. The columns fit much better that way.

It warns, it does not refuse, because a manager often knows a week is quiet. The warning names who else is off so you can decide without leaving the page.

articles.title: Pro rata allowance for part-time staff
articles.body:
This page covers pro rata allowance for part-time staff from start to finish. It lives under Time off.

1. Put the contracted hours on the staff record.
2. Tick Work out pro rata on the same record.
3. The allowance shows as a share of the venue standard, to the nearest half day.

The rest of the team carry on working while you do this. Nothing is taken offline.

This is one of the few things an owner can do that a manager cannot, so it may need somebody else in the building.

The same page looks slightly different on the older layout. The buttons are in the same order, they are just along the top rather than down the side.

Somebody who joins partway through the holiday year gets their allowance worked out from their start date as well, so both reductions apply to the same person.

articles.title: Recording sickness
articles.body:
This is our page on recording sickness. The screens sit in slightly different places on a phone, but the order of the steps is the same either way.

1. Open the staff record and press Add absence rather than booking time off.
2. Choose Sickness, set the days and add a note if you need one.
3. Sickness comes off the rota but never off the holiday allowance.

Sickness on a day somebody was rota'd leaves the shift showing as needing cover, which is what puts it in front of whoever is filling the week.

articles.title: Setting your holiday year
articles.body:
People write in about setting your holiday year most in the first week of the month, when everybody is publishing. The page is Settings > Time off.

1. Open Settings > Time off and set the month your holiday year starts.
2. Most venues use January or April; it does not have to match your financial year.
3. Save, and the allowance figures redraw against the new year.

Give it a moment on venue wifi. The page catches up on its own and there is no need to do it twice.

The same page looks slightly different on the older layout. The buttons are in the same order, they are just along the top rather than down the side.

Changing the month partway through leaves everybody with a short year, and the allowance is worked out pro rata for it. It is worth doing at the end of a year rather than the middle.

articles.title: The allowance a member of staff sees left
articles.body:
The page for the allowance a member of staff sees left is Time off. It has changed a little since last year and this article has been brought up to date with it.

- They open the app, tap You, then Time off.
- The figure is the allowance less what is approved and less what is taken.
- Requests waiting on a manager are shown separately underneath.

Every manager at that venue can open this, and so can the owner.

The figure counts the whole holiday year, including days later in the year they have already booked, which is why it can look lower than somebody expects in the spring.

articles.title: The holiday allowance for a venue
articles.body:
People write in about the holiday allowance for a venue most in the first week of the month, when everybody is publishing. The page is Settings > Time off.

- Open Settings > Time off and set the standard allowance for the venue.
- Choose whether you are counting in days or in hours before you enter the figure.
- Override it on any individual staff record where somebody has a different deal.

Changing the venue allowance does not touch anybody who already has an override on their record, which is how a long-serving member of staff keeps their extra days when you change the standard.

articles.title: Time off for somebody who works at two venues
articles.body:
This article is about time off for somebody who works at two venues. Everything below is done from Time off, and you need to be a manager or the owner of the account to see the page at all.

1. Book it once, from either venue; it blocks both.
2. The days come off one allowance, because the allowance belongs to the person.
3. Both sets of managers see the booking on their own rota.

The rest of the team carry on working while you do this. Nothing is taken offline.

Everything here can be undone from the same page, so it is worth trying it out on a quiet day before you lean on it.

This is one of the few things an owner can do that a manager cannot, so it may need somebody else in the building.

The request itself goes only to the managers of their main venue, so the other site finds out when the booking lands on the rota rather than being asked first.

articles.title: Time off that lands on a bank holiday
articles.body:
A couple of the steps below depend on how your venue settings are set, so have those to hand before you start. The page is Settings > Rotas.

1. Check that the day is marked as observed under Settings > Rotas first.
2. Book the time off as normal across the dates you want.
3. Observed bank holidays inside the booking are skipped and not counted.

If two of you are in the same page at once, the last one to save wins, so it is worth saying out loud who is doing it.

If you are not sure whether something saved, the account history under Settings lists the last ninety days with a name against every line.

On a phone, turn it sideways. The columns fit much better that way.

If the day is not marked as observed it counts as an ordinary day and comes off the allowance, which is the most common reason somebody says their allowance is a day out.

articles.title: Turning a holiday request down
articles.body:
This page covers turning a holiday request down from start to finish. It lives under Time off.

1. Open the request and press Decline.
2. Write a line saying why; the member of staff sees exactly what you type.
3. The days go back on their allowance straight away.

It applies from today forward. Anything that has already gone through is left as it was.

If you are not sure whether something saved, the account history under Settings lists the last ninety days with a name against every line.

A declined request cannot be approved afterwards. If you change your mind, ask them to put it in again, or book it for them from the same page.

articles.title: Unpaid leave
articles.body:
Here is what to do about unpaid leave, step by step. You will find the page at Time off.

- Book it the same way as holiday and choose Unpaid for the type.
- The days block the rota and show on the year, but do not touch the allowance.
- Unpaid days are left out of the hours that go to payroll.

Anything you change here goes into the account history with your name and the time against it, so there is always a record of who did what.

Most venues set this up in their first fortnight and then leave it alone from one year to the next.

Unpaid leave still counts towards the how many people are off at once figure, because the venue is a body down either way.

articles.title: Who a holiday request goes to
articles.body:
What follows is our answer on who a holiday request goes to. Open Settings > Permissions before you start.

- A request goes to the managers of the venue on that person's staff record.
- Check the venue on the record if requests are landing with the wrong person.
- Add or remove managers for a venue under Settings > Permissions.

You are asked to confirm before anything is changed for good, and the confirmation says in plain words what is about to happen.

Only owners and managers can do this. A staff account can see the page but the buttons are greyed out.

Somebody who works at two venues sends their requests to the managers of the venue marked as their main one, not to both.

accounts.name: The Sorting Office Bar and Grill
Thorne and Vale Bar and Grill

tickets.subject: bank holiday booking?
tickets.message:
Hello Hollins, Somebody booked the bank holiday Monday off and it has taken a whole day off her allowance. She does not normally work Mondays. We close on bank holidays anyway. Can I put the day back on without deleting the booking? I did try ringing earlier but I think I caught you at lunch, so I thought I would write it all down instead and you can pick it up whenever suits. My assistant manager has tried it as well and gets exactly the same. Hope that makes sense.
Delphine

tickets.subject: double booked a member of staff
tickets.message:
Hello again, I have double booked somebody and only found out when she told me. I thought there was meant to be a warning for that. She works at both of our sites which might be why. I have written it out as best I can, tell me what else you need. It is only twelve of us at this site. Whenever you have a minute.
Ines
tickets.reply: Hi Ines, the warning was there but it is on the other venue's rota, not yours, because the second shift was at the second site. It is a red corner on that week. I have shortened the kitchen shift by two hours so the two no longer overlap. Marcus

tickets.subject: update an email address
tickets.message:
Dear Hollins Rota support, I need to change the email on a staff record and I cannot find the field. Will it sign her out of the app? She cannot get into the old one at all any more. We are on team, if that matters at all. We have been with you long enough that I should know this, I am sure. Thanks for your time.

Kind regards,
Anton
tickets.reply: Hi Anton, Approving a holiday request is the closest we have written down. Take what applies and I will fill in the rest if you need me to. Callum

tickets.subject: How do I cancel time off
tickets.message:
Hi, sorry to bother you again, One of the bar team has asked to cancel the week he booked for October. How do I take it back off? The rota for that week is already published. I want the days back on his allowance if that is possible. We have been with you long enough that I should know this, I am sure. No rush on this one.
Saoirse

tickets.subject: App is empty for one of them
tickets.message:
Hi, The app shows this week but nothing for next, and the rota is definitely published. Everybody else can see theirs. He has pulled down to refresh and it made no difference. I do the office side and my business partner does the floor. It is not urgent today but I would like it sorted before the end of the month. Appreciate it.
Ola
tickets.reply: Hello Ola, Approving the week's hours is the page I would start from for this. Work through it and come back to me with anything it leaves open. Callum

tickets.subject: Invitation never arrived
tickets.message:
Good morning, Two new people have not had their invitation emails and they start Monday. It is a hotmail address if that means anything. She has checked spam. I have had a look through the help centre but I am going round in circles. It was working the week before, which is why it stands out. No rush on this one.
Saoirse

tickets.subject: Time off request will not approve
tickets.message:
hi there, there is a holiday request sat in my list and the approve button does nothing when i press it. i can approve everybody else's, it is just his. he works at both venues if that makes a difference. this started sometime last week i think. it has been like this for three or four days now. nothing pressing, just when you can.
verity
tickets.reply: Hi Verity, this is covered in Approving a holiday request. If you would rather I changed it at this end instead, just say and I will do it while you are on. Callum

tickets.subject: Old android phone
tickets.message:
Hello, The app will not install on one of the team's phones, it says it is not compatible! Is there anything else he can use? He does not want a new phone and I do not blame him. Appreciate it. Apologies, mid-service here.
Hugo
tickets.reply: Hi Hugo, this is covered in Getting the app on a phone. If you would rather I changed it at this end instead, just say and I will do it while you are on. Priya

tickets.subject: Proper invoices please
tickets.message:
Dear Hollins Rota support, My accountant needs proper VAT invoices for the last six months. Our VAT number is on the account already I think. Year end is the end of this month. We have been on the team plan since we joined. My area manager is asking about it, which is really why I am writing rather than leaving it, and she will want something in writing that I can forward on to her. No rush on this one.

Kind regards,
Nadia
tickets.reply: Hi Nadia, your VAT number was not on the account, which is why they came out as receipts. I have added it from your details and rebuilt all six. They keep their original numbers and dates, so your accountant will be happy. Priya

tickets.subject: Overtime missing
tickets.message:
Afternoon, Overtime is showing as zero for everybody this week which cannot be right. We pay time adn a quarter over that. Their contract says forty. We are on team, if that matters at all. It is only twenty-two of us at this site. Next week is fine if that is easier.
Sami
tickets.reply: Hello Sami, nobody at your venue has contracted hours set, which is why it is nought across the board. I have put the standard forty on everybody full time and left the part timers for you, since those will all be different. Callum

tickets.subject: Paying for leavers
tickets.message:
Hi there, This month's bill counts thirty one people and we only have twenty six. Can that be put right on the next bill? I marked them all as leavers in August. There are twenty-nine of us on the books at the moment. It is not urgent today but I would like it sorted before the end of the month. Whenever you have a minute.
Yusuf
tickets.reply: Hi Yusuf, What counts as an active member of staff is the article for this. Have a read, and if anything in it does not match what you are seeing, send me a screenshot and I will pick it up. Callum

tickets.subject: matching screen shows her twice
tickets.message:
Hi, sorry to bother you again, One of the kitchen team is in payroll under her married name and in here under her old one, and the transfer keeps refusing her. I would rather not break the other one. Her hours have not gone through for two weeks now. We are a small team so it is usually me doing all of this. It is not urgent today but I would like it sorted before the end of the month. No rush on this one.
Anton
tickets.reply: Hi Anton, match ours to whichever one payroll is actually paying, then mark the other as not in payroll so it stops coming back at you. Putting her payroll reference on her staff record here will keep the two tied together from now on. Callum

tickets.subject: App keeps signing people out
tickets.message:
